messages:
maria-g: Quick heads up — the Q1 pricing experiment created a few prepaid invoices that were booked to revenue instead of deferred. We need to lock the deferral schedule before close and decide accruals for usage true-ups.
aj: thanks — can you list the affected invoices?
maria-g: Sent the sheet: https://drive.redwood.example.com/sheets/prepay-q1-experiment (only finance team). Short summary: 3 annual prepay Dedicated contracts ($180k total) booked as ARR; two commit credits applied as one-off discounts.
kevin_chen: Do we have the original purchase dates and start-of-service dates? That impacts the monthly deferral amounts.
maria-g: Purchase dates are in the sheet. Service start for all three is 2026-02-01. Billing dates vary (one billed 2026-01-15, others 2026-02-05).
rebecca-smith: For revenue recognition, we should move the billed amounts into Deferred Revenue and amortize monthly from 2026-02-01 over 12 months. The commit credits should reduce the deferred amount pro rata unless they're usage credits — need confirmation.
aj: I'll confirm credit type with Billing system. If credits were recorded as contra-revenue not as prepaid credits, we'll need an adjustment.
kevin_chen: For the AJE, proposal:
```
Dr Revenue - Subscription    180,000
  Cr Deferred Revenue        180,000
(To reclassify misbooked prepaids into deferral)
```
Then monthly recognition: Dr Deferred Revenue 15,000 / Cr Revenue 15,000 starting Feb.
maria-g: That looks right. For the two invoices with applied commit credits, if credits were recorded as discounts at invoice level, the deferred amount is net of discounts. If they were recorded as separate liability, we need to reduce deferred revenue by the credit liability and recognize on usage.
accounting-bot: automated-check: Found 2 invoices where "commit_credit" line item = true and posted to GL code 4002 (Revenue). Flagged for manual review.
rebecca-smith: Action items: 1) AJ confirm credit treatment today. 2) Kevin prepare AJE for reclass and provide journal ID to close team. 3) Maria attach final deferral schedule to close checklist.
aj: Confirmed — credits were applied as invoice-level discounts (netted). No separate liability.
kevin_chen: Ok I'll post the reclassing AJE this afternoon and tag the journal ID here. Also will include the automated memo: "Reclass prepaid annual Dedicated packages from revenue to deferred revenue per ASC 606 — service starts 2026-02-01."
maria-g: Appreciate it. Last ask: can we keep a one-line note for auditors explaining the pricing experiment and why these were misbooked? I can draft.
rebecca-smith: Yes — please add: experiment ran Jan 15–Feb 1; temporary billing flow changed; corrected entries made before close; amounts and amort schedules attached.
kevin_chen: Posted journal 94122 — Dr Rev 180,000 / Cr Def Rev 180,000. Leaving memo and attachment in NetSuite.
maria-g: Perfect. I'll drop the final deferral schedule into the close binder and ping legal for a short note for auditors. :thumbsup:
rebecca-smith: Closing checklist updated. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
accounting-bot: close-notification: Thread resolved and tagged month-end action items.
